schema: Joyful Journeys r1 direct reopen and source/geometry validation

properties.use: Joyful Journey adult day service; former single-family home per 2014 county zoning staff report
properties.source_footprint: OSM way 869182111 (name/address match), visually checked against Esri World Imagery export; roof perimeter proxy, not surveyed wall line

properties.roof_form: approximate multi-facet gable from aerial; exact ridge layout unverified

footprint_comparison.important_caveat: The source ring is inherited from baseline geometry; numerical agreement is not independent survey evidence. Aerial overlay is the independent visual check.

known_limitations: 7.35 m height is an estimate; overall bounds include a 0.06 m ridge cap, for a maximum Z of 7.41 m.

Floor count, wall height, roof ridge arrangement and roof pitch are not measured. The model is one main level with attic-like roof mass, based on the 2014 zoning report describing a single-family home and aerial roof profile.
Facade finish, window rhythm and entrance canopy are schematic; no building elevations were located.
Master audit had no official Purdue GIS feature match for this building. OSM identity and Esri imagery support the match, but are not a survey.
Coordinator-owned manifest still records 16.0 m vertical bounds and should be refreshed after review.
